purpose: Icon glyphs for the Galaxy Gardeners Decentraland scene station screens. The files listed under 'icons' are transparent placeholders to be replaced with real artwork.

style.look: A single flat white (#FFFFFF, fully opaque) glyph on a fully transparent background. No colour, no gradients, no outline, no drop shadow, no background shape. The scene tints the white glyph cyan at runtime, so any colour in the file is wrong.
style.geometry: Glyph centred, filling roughly 70-80% of the canvas, with even padding. Minimum stroke thickness about 24 px at 512 px so it stays legible when rendered 20-40 cm tall in 3D. Simple geometric shapes; readable as a silhouette.
style.reference_note: Match the weight and simplicity of the existing icons above. The concept art these belong to is a dark navy sci-fi interface with thin cyan lines (see docs/superpowers/specs/references/*.png).

icons.name: Fuel
icons.glyph: A single liquid drop / fuel droplet, solid silhouette.
icons.used_for: Ship station Overview: FUEL frame header.

icons.name: Upgrades
icons.glyph: A wrench, angled about 45 degrees, solid silhouette.
icons.used_for: Ship station Overview: UPGRADES button; Systems view header.

icons.name: Ship Systems
icons.glyph: A small angular emblem: two or three slanted parallel bars forming a chevron-like mark (like a stylised ship insignia).
icons.used_for: Ship station Systems view header (top-left of the screen).

icons.name: Ship Stats
icons.glyph: A bar chart: three or four vertical bars of different heights on a baseline.
icons.used_for: Ship station low screen: SHIP STATS header.

icons.name: Active Missions
icons.glyph: A target / crosshair: a circle with a centre dot and four short tick marks.
icons.used_for: Ship station low screen: ACTIVE MISSIONS header.

icons.name: Resource Inventory
icons.glyph: A cluster of three crystal shards / gems, solid silhouette.
icons.used_for: Flora station: RESOURCE INVENTORY tile and view header.

icons.name: Check
icons.used_for: Ship Systems view: required resource satisfied.

icons.name: Cross
icons.used_for: Ship Systems view: required resource missing.

deliverable: Return one PNG per entry, named exactly as 'file' (path relative to the project root), overwriting the placeholder.

textures.name: Ship blueprint
textures.look: Technical blueprint / wireframe line drawing of the DaisyClass ship (the 3D model at assets/models/DaisyClass_Exterior.glb: a flat, roughly circular petal-shaped hull) seen from above or three-quarter view. Thin cyan (#00E5FF) lines with faint dimension marks and a subtle grid, on a FULLY TRANSPARENT background. No fill, no dark backing, no text. Matches the wireframe ship in docs/superpowers/specs/references/ship-overview-concept.png and ship-upgrades-concept.png.
textures.used_for: Ship station: Overview right frame and Systems view center, drawn flat on the screen glass.
textures.deliverable: One PNG named exactly as 'file', overwriting the transparent placeholder.

textures.name: Exploration bay
textures.look: Isometric technical line-art of a pod bay: a row of four open cradles holding sleek survey pods, thin cyan (#00E5FF) lines with a faint grid, fully transparent background, no text. Matches the bay thumbnails in docs/superpowers/specs/references/pod-operations-concept.png.
textures.used_for: Ship station, Pod Operations view: EXPLORATION BAY card thumbnail.
textures.deliverable: One PNG named exactly as 'file', overwriting the transparent placeholder.

textures.name: Mining bay
textures.look: Same style as exploration-bay.png but the cradles hold stockier drill-nosed mining pods.
textures.used_for: Ship station, Pod Operations view: MINING BAY card thumbnail.
textures.deliverable: One PNG named exactly as 'file', overwriting the transparent placeholder.
